The '''2020–21 Tahiti Ligue 1''' is the 74th season of the [[Tahiti Ligue 1]], the top-flight [[Association football|football]] league in [[Tahiti]]. The season started on 08 October 2020.<ref>[https://www.rsssf.org/tablest/tahiti2021.html], RSSSF.com</ref> [[A.S. Pirae]] are the defending champions.

==Format Change==
Due to a 3-month interruption caused by the Covid-19 pandemic, only a single round robin will be played, followed by a playoff between the top-4 to determine the championship and qualification for the OFC Champions League <ref>[https://www.rsssf.org/tablest/tahiti2021.html], RSSSF.com</ref>
==Teams==
A total of thirteen teams compete in the league. Due the [[COVID-19 pandemic in French Polynesia]], the [[2019-20 Tahiti Ligue 1|last season]] was cancelled with no relegation. [[A.S. Excelsior (Tahiti)|Excelsior]], [[A.S. Mataiea|Mataiea]] and [[A.S. Arue|Arue]] were promoted. [[A.S. Taravao AC|Taravao AC]] changed name to AS Pueu.
